placements.title: A memory submitted without an explicit id still resolves to a slug — via LLM id-gen or the deterministic slugify fallback — and the file commits successfully
placements.frame: Does this expression show the pipeline turning a missing id into a slug (through the LLM id-gen path or the deterministic fallback) and completing the commit, rather than failing or requiring a caller-supplied id?
placements.why: src-1 states the triggering condition future envelopes about this pipeline will keep recurring to — a memory arriving with no explicit id — and src-2 states the standing behavior contract the system must satisfy in that condition (produce a slug via one of two named paths, then commit). Together they name a subject the pipeline's design will keep being tested against, not a one-time fact: this is the missing-id-handling theme itself, not a measurement of it. No existing strata or narrative structure was supplied to reuse, so this is minted standalone with no forced parent — foundational for this graph.
